info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Refunds-v4-spec
info.description: The Payment Refunds API allows businesses to efficiently manage refund requests for processed payments. This endpoint enables users to retrieve a list of all payment refunds, facilitating transparency and tracking of refund transactions. It is particularly useful for customer service teams, finance departments, and other stakeholders involved in handling payment discrepancies or customer inquiries. By using this API, organizations can ensure swift resolution of refund-related issues while maintaining accurate financial records.

get.summary: Retrieve refund details for a specific payment.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information about a refund associated with a specific payment. It returns various attributes of the refund such as amount, status, and reason, helping to track and manage refund processes efficiently.
